text.description_html:
Emtek BTB-76028, San Carlos Wrought Steel Back-to-Back Pulls

The 8 Inch San Carlos Back-to-Back Door Pull has a rustic look that makes it a great choice for period style homes. The San Carlos Wrought Steel Back-to-Back Pull Set comes packaged with 2 door handles and mounting hardware. It will fit doors 1-3/8 inches to 2-1/4 inches thick. The San Carlos Pull Set is available in either a flat black steel or satin steel finish. Both of these finish colors have a rough texture for a truly historic end look.

Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Packaged with 2 door pulls (1 door pull for each side of a door).

Also Available: San Carlos Pull with Thru-Bolt Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek San Carlos Pull Set:

  • Material: Wrought Steel
  • Total Length: 12-1/4"
  • Center to Center Length: 8"
  • Pull Handle Width: 1-1/16"
  • Total Projection: 2-7/16"
  • Mount Height: 2-1/4"
  • Mount Width: 1-1/8"
  • Door Thickness: for doors 1-3/8" to 2-1/4" thick.
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.

Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back-to-Back mounting.
